emails.subject: Re: Frame agreement renewal for the 7.5 kW frequency converter
emails.body:
Dear Selvbrunn Drive Systems GmbH team,

Thank you for your renewal proposal and for explaining the context behind it. With your pricing constraints in mind, we would welcome a discussion of a longer agreement, extended payment terms and greater call-off flexibility, focusing first on adjustments within your existing approval authority. We are happy to work through these points step by step and respect your internal approval process.

We confirm a binding volume of 4,580 units per year for 36 months. Labour cost index DE, manufacturing, seasonally and calendar adjusted (quarterly, carried to its three months) changed +1.7% from 2025-12 to 2026-06 (idx:LCI-C@2025-12, idx:LCI-C@2026-06). Producer prices DE: electronic components changed +5.3% from 2026-02 to 2026-08 (idx:PPI-C2611@2026-02, idx:PPI-C2611@2026-08).

On this basis we propose the attached term sheets (unit_price 423.56, payment_days 14, contract_months 36, volume_per_year 4580; unit_price 425.06, payment_days 30, contract_months 36, volume_per_year 4580; unit_price 426.49, payment_days 45, contract_months 36, volume_per_year 4580). Please let us know which option works best for you.

Kind regards,
Purchasing, Hollerau Pumpenwerke
